mapper.sql: s.source_id, s.source_name, s.provider, COALESCE(ws.work_count, 0) AS work_count, COALESCE(fs.original_file_count, 0) AS original_file_count, COALESCE(fs.matched_file_count, 0) AS matched_file_count, COALESCE(fs.parsed_file_count, 0) AS parsed_file_count, COALESCE(fs.ready_file_count, 0) AS ready_file_count, COALESCE(fs.parse_failed_file_count, 0) AS parse_failed_file_count, COALESCE(fs.block_failed_file_count, 0) AS block_failed_file_count, COALESCE(fs.unsupported_file_count, 0) AS unsupported_file_count

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) AS work_count FROM work_source GROUP BY source_id ) ws ON ws.source_id = s.source_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f.source_id, COUNT(*) AS original_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_match = 1) AS matched_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_text = 2) AS parsed_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_text = 2 AND j.flag_block = 1) AS ready_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_text = -1) AS parse_failed_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_text = 2 AND j.flag_block = -1) AS block_failed_file_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_text = -2) AS unsupported_file_count FROM original_file f JOIN original_file_job j ON j.file_id = f.file_id GROUP BY f.source_id ) fs ON fs.source_id = s.source_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source s

SELECT FROM source s
ORDER BY COALESCE(ws.work_count, 0) DESC, s.source_id ASC
ORDER BY (COALESCE(fs.parse_failed_file_count, 0) + COALESCE(fs.block_failed_file_count, 0)) DESC, s.source_id ASC
ORDER BY s.source_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source) AS source_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work) AS work_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT file_id) FROM original_file) AS original_file_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT matched_work_id) FROM original_file_job WHERE flag_match = 1 AND matched_work_id IS NOT NULL ) AS matched_work_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT file_id) FROM original_file_job WHERE flag_text = 2 ) AS parsed_file_count, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT file_id) FROM original_file_job WHERE flag_block = 1 ) AS block_imported_file_count

SELECT s.source_id, s.source_name, s.provider, COALESCE(ws.work_count, 0) AS work_count, COALESCE(fs.original_file_count, 0) AS original_file_count, COALESCE(ms.matched_work_count, 0) AS matched_work_count, COALESCE(fs.parsed_file_count, 0) AS parsed_file_count, COALESCE(fs.block_imported_file_count, 0) AS block_imported_file_count FROM source s LEFT JOIN ( SELECT source_id, COUNT(DISTINCT work_id) AS work_count FROM work_source GROUP BY source_id ) ws ON ws.source_id = s.source_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT f.source_id, COUNT(DISTINCT f.file_id) AS original_file_count, COUNT(DISTINCT f.file_id) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_text = 2) AS parsed_file_count, COUNT(DISTINCT f.file_id) FILTER (WHERE j.flag_block = 1) AS block_imported_file_count FROM original_file f LEFT JOIN original_file_job j ON j.file_id = f.file_id GROUP BY f.source_id ) fs ON fs.source_id = s.source_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ws.source_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ws.work_id) AS matched_work_count FROM work_source ws JOIN original_file_job j ON j.matched_work_id = ws.work_id WHERE j.flag_match = 1 GROUP BY ws.source_id ) ms ON ms.source_id = s.source_id ORDER BY s.source_id ASC
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN j.file_id IS NULL THEN 'NO_MATCHED_FILE' WHEN j.flag_text = -2 THEN 'UNSUPPORTED_TEXT_INPUT' WHEN j.flag_text = -1 THEN 'PARSE_FAILED' WHEN j.flag_text = 1 THEN 'PARSING' WHEN j.flag_text = 2 AND j.flag_block = -1 THEN 'BLOCK_FAILED' WHEN j.flag_text = 2 AND j.flag_block = 1 THEN 'READY' WHEN j.flag_text = 2 AND j.flag_block = 0 THEN 'PARSED' ELSE 'MATCHED' END

where.if: AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_source ws_name JOIN source s_name ON s_name.source_id = ws_name.source_id WHERE ws_name.work_id = w.work_id AND LOWER(s_name.source_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{sourceName}), '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM work_author wa_filter WHERE wa_filter.work_id = w.work_id AND LOWER(wa_filter.author_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{authorName}), '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work w LEFT JOIN original_file_job j ON j.matched_work_id = w.work_id

SELECT w.work_id, w.title, w.doi, w.publication_year, w.publication_date, w.type, w.language, ( SELECT STRING_AGG(ws.source_id, ',' ORDER BY ws.source_id) FROM work_source ws WHERE ws.work_id = w.work_id ) AS source_ids, ( SELECT STRING_AGG(s.source_name, ', ' ORDER BY ws.source_id) FROM work_source ws JOIN source s ON s.source_id = ws.source_id WHERE ws.work_id = w.work_id ) AS source_names, j.file_id AS matched_file_id, j.flag_match, j.flag_text, j.flag_block FROM work w LEFT JOIN original_file_job j ON j.matched_work_id = w.work_id
ORDER BY w.publication_year ASC NULLS LAST, w.work_id ASC
ORDER BY w.title ASC NULLS LAST, w.work_id ASC
ORDER BY w.work_id ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN IN ('PARSE_FAILED', 'BLOCK_FAILED') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, w.publication_year DESC NULLS LAST, w.work_id ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN = 'READY' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, w.publication_year DESC NULLS LAST, w.work_id ASC
ORDER BY w.publication_year DESC NULLS LAST, w.work_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT w.work_id, w.title, w.doi, w.publication_year, w.publication_date, w.type, w.language, ( SELECT STRING_AGG(ws.source_id, ',' ORDER BY ws.source_id) FROM work_source ws WHERE ws.work_id = w.work_id ) AS source_ids, ( SELECT STRING_AGG(s.source_name, ', ' ORDER BY ws.source_id) FROM work_source ws JOIN source s ON s.source_id = ws.source_id WHERE ws.work_id = w.work_id ) AS source_names, j.file_id AS matched_file_id, j.flag_match, j.flag_text, j.flag_block FROM work w LEFT JOIN original_file_job j ON j.matched_work_id = w.work_id WHERE w.work_id = #{workId}
SELECT s.source_id, s.source_name, s.provider FROM work_source ws JOIN source s ON s.source_id = ws.source_id WHERE ws.work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY s.source_id ASC
SELECT author_id, author_name, author_position FROM work_author WHERE work_id = #{workId} ORDER BY author_position NULLS LAST, author_id ASC

SELECT f.file_id, f.source_id, f.year, f.paper_title, f.authors, f.doi, f.url, f.provider, f.original_file_name, f.original_file_path, f.original_file_type, f.file_size, j.flag_match, j.matched_work_id, j.flag_text, j.flag_block FROM original_file_job j JOIN original_file f ON f.file_id = j.file_id WHERE j.matched_work_id = #{workId}
SELECT file_id, file_type, file_name, file_path, file_size FROM text_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY file_type ASC
SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(file_path, '/[^/]*$', '') FROM text_file WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN file_type = 'JSON' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: f.file_id, f.source_id, s.source_name, f.year, f.paper_title, f.authors, f.doi, f.url, f.provider, f.original_file_name, f.original_file_path, f.original_file_type, f.file_size, j.flag_match, j.matched_work_id, j.flag_text, j.flag_block

where.if: AND ( LOWER(f.file_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{q}), '%') OR LOWER(f.paper_title) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{q}), '%') OR LOWER(f.authors) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{q}), '%') OR LOWER(f.doi) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{q}), '%') )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM source s_filter WHERE s_filter.source_id = f.source_id AND LOWER(s_filter.source_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{sourceName}), '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM original_file f JOIN original_file_job j ON j.file_id = f.file_id

SELECT FROM original_file f JOIN original_file_job j ON j.file_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN source s ON s.source_id = f.source_id
ORDER BY f.year DESC NULLS LAST, f.file_id ASC
ORDER BY f.file_size ASC, f.file_id ASC
ORDER BY f.provider ASC NULLS LAST, f.file_id ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN j.flag_text = -1 OR (j.flag_text = 2 AND j.flag_block = -1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, f.source_id ASC, f.file_id ASC
ORDER BY f.year DESC NULLS LAST, f.file_id ASC
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM original_file f JOIN original_file_job j ON j.file_id = f.file_id LEFT JOIN source s ON s.source_id = f.source_id WHERE f.file_id = #{fileId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM work w JOIN original_file_job j ON j.matched_work_id = w.work_id JOIN block b ON b.file_id = j.file_id WHERE w.work_id = #{workId}
AND b.block_type != 'discarded'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM block b WHERE b.file_id = #{fileId}
AND b.block_type != 'discarded'
mapper.sql: b.block_id, b.file_id, b.block_type, b.block_text, b.pdf_page, b.pdf_bbox::text AS pdf_bbox_json, b.block_seq, b.parent_title_block_id, b.title_level, bi.image_path, bi.image_caption, bi.image_footnote, bt.image_path AS table_image_path, bt.table_caption, bt.table_footnote, be.image_path AS equation_image_path, be.format AS equation_format, bf.footnote_label, bf.footnote_text, ( SELECT REGEXP_REPLACE(tf.file_path, '/[^/]*$', '') FROM text_file tf WHERE tf.file_id = b.file_id ORDER BY CASE WHEN tf.file_type = 'JSON' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1 ) AS parsed_directory, STRING_AGG(br.reference_text, CHR(10) ORDER BY br.reference_seq) FILTER (WHERE br.reference_text IS NOT NULL) AS references_text

LEFT JOIN block_image bi ON bi.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_table bt ON bt.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_equation be ON be.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_footnote bf ON bf.block_id = b.block_id LEFT JOIN block_reference br ON br.block_id = b.block_id
